paragraphs: Hello Heart sells a heart health program that combines connected devices, clinical expertise and AI-based guidance. Employers, health plans and labor unions are named as the organizations that work with the company to reach their people.

Members take daily readings with an FDA-cleared monitor. The app keeps blood pressure, cholesterol, weight, activity and medications in one place. A separate medication service brings together an AI assistant, a connected pill box and pharmacist-led reviews. That assistant is available at any hour for common heart health questions.

The company describes itself as an AI company focused on preventive heart health. It lists offices in the United States and Israel. It also says it is part of the American Heart Association Innovators network. Public employers appear among its client stories, including the City of Minneapolis, Minnesota, where cardiovascular conditions are called a top three cost driver.

quote.text: Heart disease is common, costly, and often preventable.
